_doc: Midjourney prompts. Art direction 'Faceted Hero' (coordinator, 2026-10-23 09:51Z): low-poly faceted, flat-shaded planes, no textures; matte gunmetal with glowing orange light strips, cyan for machines and Star Child, real glass for Star Child, visors and crystals; plain light grey background, orthographic. Heroes: A-pose, arms a little away from the body, no helmet, square to camera, plus a front/side/back turnaround. Parts and props: one per frame, orthographic three-quarter view (square-on would hide their depth). 'attach' is uploaded with Attach to prompt as the likeness reference.
